notes.title: 🌊 Swim with us toward World Ocean Day Festival and help us save marine life! 🐳
notes.content:
The ocean is cruicial for our entire planet's ecosystems, producing more oxygen and absorbing more carbon than all the forests combined 💧 This event is all about protecting it and its many incredible inhabitants. 

World Ocean Day Festival is an event by Games For Waves, gaming and streaming community created by Whale and Dolphin Conservation. The goal? To connect gaming industry with real-world conservation efforts. The festival kicks off today and Untold Tales joins in with The Cub + Golf Club Nostalgia bundle and many other titles!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/1100d557d97384564b6d41b5b928ce40cf02a4ba.png

🗓️ From June 5th to 12th, we're pledging 20% of our net profits to Whale and Dolphin Conservation and you get to purchase our games, The Cub + Golf Club Nostalgia bundle included, at deep discounts. This year, every purchase WDC to protect the ocean and the seas from deadly lost and discarded fishing gear! 🛶🎣🐟

[previewyoutube=7TmAZSZtikA;full][/previewyoutube]

 About The Cub + Golf Club Nostalgia bundle

Everything You Need, Bundled Together.

Arise: A Simple Story
Embark on an emotional journey of losing the love of one's life. Manipulate time, solve puzzles, reshape surroundings as you push forward into the bittersweet recollections of a past life. This is a story about happiness and hardship, joy and sorrow. A story that all of us will one day experience.

Bang-On Balls: Chronicles
A quirky, absolutely content-packed, destructible open-world sandbox adventure with combat, platforming, character customization, and collect-a-thon scavenger hunt experience. Play solo, 2-player split screen, or online co-op for up to 4 players. No paid cosmetic DLC nonsense.

💦 So, are you ready to dive in? Support marine life and celebrate the ocean with The Cub + Golf Club Nostalgia bundle:

notes.title: Connecting Worlds
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160742/eaa619f3ed67ca9c2c0738c64101d5420f5f19bc.png
Welcome to the Connecting Worlds series, where our main objective is to showcase the creation of The Cub's world, delving into the primary design goals and the topics we aim to explore within this presented universe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160742/8490b390c438b93699843281b2b2d90ee5498840.png
You might wonder how difficult was it to adapt a world used as a golfing course into a challenging parkour arena. 

TL;DR version would be: “The world primarily evolved practically”.

And if you want to dive deeper you need to know that the buildings and monuments which were mostly in the background in Golf Club Nostalgia are now integral parts of the level design that the Cub runs across, climbs, etc. This means that the urban ruins must simultaneously be beautiful and legible, feel organic, but also function as clear obstacles for a platformer. In many ways this was the main challenge and required a lot of testing and trying because it depends on the feel and flow, unlike Golf Club Nostalgia, which is basically turn-based: you hit the ball, the character automatically goes to the next spot, and you swing again. 

The Cub is free in the world, and we wanted him to physically walk and touch monuments and buildings that were once mere background decorations in Golf Club Nostalgia.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160742/fe9e9b6ddc8383ace3fd269efbfe7f94c0785be1.png

notes.title: A Sneak Peek at ATONE Combat and Music
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/38993a11746e685279592e53ebfab7d29aaa5bb9.png

Hello Midgardians!

ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree, the upcoming title from our friends at Untold Tales and Wildboy Studios, launches in just 10 short days, so we wanted to provide a nice snippet of combat and a preview of the incredible soundtrack that awaits you. 

FIGHT TO THE BEAT

Combat is all about surviving to the end of the song. Let's have a quick look at a battle against the Ice King in Hard Mode.

[previewyoutube=rv55TIzzBgs;full][/previewyoutube]

Keep focused and stick to the rhythm and you'll land a strike. But make too many mistakes and it'll cost you! 

If you find yourself struggling or unable to vanquish your enemies, there's always Normal Moe which makes the notes appear on 2 rails only. There is also Story Mode, where combat is entirely winnable, every time, allowing you to focus on the incredible narrative.

All fights can then be replayed in the Arena Mode for those wanting that perfect score or certain trophies.

A TASTE OF THE TUNES

We've also got a little sneak peak at the amazing in-game OST, composed by the talented James Shuar also know in the electronica scene as Luminist, as well as contributions from composer Andrew Prahlow (The Outer Wilds). 

Have a listen to "Sons of Fenrir" and transport yourself to the wilds of ATONE.

[previewyoutube=ls_CZHd7p_M;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for reading!

♥️ It would be very helpful if you follow and wishlist the game below ♥️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/894620/ATONE_Heart_of_the_Elder_Tree/

notes.title: ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree joins Untold Tales
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Three years ago, we launched our first ever title as a studio with ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree. It was received with critical acclaim and won several awards, and we were so humbled by all the support and love for the unique Norse world we created.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/4005a0aa7ce0f645ef6de4804fc79f41f34448ac.png

Now, we have several announcements to share with you all! 

New Publisher
First up, we're happy to share that we have an official publisher: Untold Tales! They've been a great partner and will support us in all efforts to bring our game to you as smoothly as possible. So go on and give them a follow! -> 

Release Window
Second, we're excited to confirm that we're targeting launch in early 2023. We understand that it's not an exact date, but game development can fluctuate wildly and we don't want to promise something only to disappoint! AND, we'll also be launching on Nintendo Switch, so you can find us there if that's more your style.

Next Fest Demo Available Now
Last but certainly not least, we have a free demo for you to try as part of Next Fest! That's right, it's available now. So keep that axe sharp, you'll need it! And when you're done playing, come back and give us your thoughts. We'd love to hear them!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/894620

If you enjoyed what you played, please wishlist and spread the word, as that helps immensely to increase awareness. Be sure to follow our social channels below for all news and future updates on ATONE.

Twitter: https://twitter.com/UntoldTalesHQ
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/untoldtalesgames
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@untoldtaleshq

Cheers!
Wildboy Studios and Untold Tales

notes.title: Golf Club: Wasteland E3 Wrap Up
notes.content:
Hello all you Martians out there.

As we come to an end to the E3 chaos, we thought we'd highlight a few of our favorite pieces we had with Golf Club: Wasteland.

First off, we announced the game at the start of E3 week with IGN as part of their Summer of Gaming showcase.

[previewyoutube=3vIAmbHr9d8;full][/previewyoutube]

This led to a slew of positive comments from players and pick-up from the wider gaming press. Turns out people really want to go golfing on the desolate husk of our planet. You people are monsters. ːsteamhappyː

“Golf Club: Wasteland is one of the prettiest golf games I’ve seen” - Destructoid

notes.title: Golf Club Wasteland Demo Now Available
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309404/545a0b487ed42b1f36a02d3b7d7b18345929c56b.png

Hello all you lucky Martian inhabitants. 

We're happy to announce the first test flights back to earth to tee off for a round of golf among our once beautiful home planet, have begun. To get your ticket on the shuttles back home, just download the Golf Club Wasteland demo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309404/69add59760007f7aa083118c2e4f363d5bf3b96b.jpg

The demo / starter package tour offers 6 holes from around the globe. So you aren't lonely we'll also beam down the Radio Nostalgia from Mars radio broadcast. Bandwidth is still limited here on Mars so the broadcast may be cut short. But don't worry, it'll be just enough to get your first fix.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309404/6fbcd645189b60a3313f7ed1bc8b523c460a1d38.jpg

There are also two modes to try - story and challenge. Story mode lets you play at your own leisurely pace. Take in the sights and sounds of fallen earth while getting a glimpse into the story of how humanity fell.

Challenge mode (which unlocks after reaching 3 for the first time) gives you a limited amount of stokes to sink your shot. Go above the allocated swings and our patented "Balls Be Gone" electronic system will detect your incompetence and self-destruct your ball on the spot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309404/4b015290d84ceb36b3ed3a2d7836ab01026fe5af.jpg

Check out the Golf Club Wasteland page to download the demo and if you'd like to book a flight for the full tour, make sure to wishlist the game to be the first to know when we launch.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1556870/Golf_Club_Wasteland/

- Tesla City Golf Tours
